device.notes: NTP Telnet TCP 23 or RS-232 38400 8N1; LF; same strings on both. Static IP. In Nexia software tag Instance IDs: MicIn = PM Input 4 Channel, LineIn = PM Stereo In 12 Channel, LineOut = PM Stereo Out 6 Channel. Device ID 1. Mic gain 0–66 dB step 6; line gain 0/6/12/18; levels −100 to +12 dB; out FS 0/6/12/18/24 dBu. Line 1–12 are the six RCA pairs (1L/1R…6L/6R). Presets are 1001+. GETD polls; parse takes the last number so telnet echo does not steal the channel index. Auto mixer / matrix / EQ are layout-specific — tag those blocks and ask for a follow-up. Omits CLEAR/RESET/REBOOT and SET IP.
